sources.title: Emergent supersymmetry at large N

evidence.text: Perturbative β-functions, anomalous dimensions and stability matrices through three loops; two-loop calculations use RGBeta, supplemented by general three-loop formulas. Composite-operator anomalous dimensions use the dummy-field method, including operator mixing.

sources.title: RG fixed points in six-dimensions via branes at orbifold singularities

evidence.text: Compute quartic gauge anomalies using representation trace identities, then seek factorization into sums of real squares. Tensor-scalar couplings to tr F² cancel the factorized anomaly and determine scalar-dependent inverse gauge couplings.

sources.title: Anti-de Sitter geometry and strongly coupled gauge theories

evidence.text: Start with the near-horizon M2-brane AdS4×S7 metric and quotient the transverse complex coordinates by an ADE action. For the explicit cyclic case, project S7⊂C4 onto the acted-on C² plane to describe the internal quotient through S3 fibers over a four-disk.

sources.title: A Comment on nonsupersymmetric fixed points and duality at large N

evidence.text: Evaluate localized singularity mass and three-form charge couplings on the unperturbed background, neglecting backreaction. A separate asymptotically flat force argument diagnoses attraction versus repulsion; it does not directly compute the field-theory potential.

sources.title: Emergent supersymmetry at large N

evidence.text: Orbifold/orientifold projections relate planar diagrams after coupling rescaling. Padé approximants extrapolate ε expansions to d=3 and d=2; poles and crossings of operators with identical quantum numbers serve as reliability diagnostics.

sources.title: RG fixed points in six-dimensions via branes at orbifold singularities

evidence.text: Use hyper-Kähler quotient quivers, index-theorem instanton dimensions including boundary η-invariant contributions, Higgs-branch dimension counts and flat directions describing instantons leaving the singularity. Matching dimensions and these motions supplies evidence for proposed moduli-space identifications.

sources.title: On nonsupersymmetric CFT in four-dimensions

evidence.text: Does the nonsupersymmetric gauge theory on self-dual Type 0 D3-branes inherit all-orders planar finiteness from N = 4 super-Yang–Mills, despite retaining SO(6) global symmetry? The paper also identifies a further SO(6)-invariant central orbifold.

sources.title: Renormalization group flows from holography supersymmetry and a c theorem

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric nonconformal gauge-theory flow have an explicit, controlled supergravity description, a detailed infrared operator map, and a monotonic holographic function interpolating between fixed-point anomaly coefficients?

sources.title: Branes and six-dimensional supersymmetric theories

evidence.text: How can brane configurations realize anomaly-free six-dimensional (0,1) theories, their proposed interacting strong-coupling fixed points, small-instanton transitions, and ultraviolet completions with gravity decoupled?

evidence.text: How does gauge fixing the single M5-brane produce an interacting six-dimensional (0,2) tensor multiplet, when does its quadratic action possess rigid superconformal symmetry, and how is that symmetry related to the near-horizon geometry?

sources.title: Anomalies, Conformal Manifolds, and Spheres

evidence.text: Analyze logarithms and contact terms in marginal-operator and stress-tensor correlators. In d=2 this imposes constraints beyond Wess–Zumino consistency: the extra parity-odd two-form is closed and the candidate connection curvatures vanish locally.

sources.title: Moduli space of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 super Yang-Mills from AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Constructs the family through double Wick rotation, a nontrivial diffeomorphism and reparametrization of known black holes, retaining a regular massless sector.

sources.title: Anomalies, Conformal Manifolds, and Spheres

evidence.text: Construct superspace anomaly sigma models, expand components and integrate the anomaly on spheres. The d=4 construction uses a target-covariant FTPR-type operator; consistency fixes its connection to be Levi-Civita.

sources.title: Anomalies, Conformal Manifolds, and Spheres

evidence.text: Classify local Weyl variations using spacetime and target-space covariance, Wess–Zumino consistency, and equivalence under variations of local counterterms. Nonremovable terms are universal anomalies.

sources.title: Moduli space of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 super Yang-Mills from AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Uses asymptotic radial expansions and holographic renormalization with boundary counterterms to identify scalar sources, VEVs and the stress tensor. Eliminates interior parameters to express regular solutions in terms of boundary data.

sources.title: Moduli space of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 super Yang-Mills from AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Solves the STU Killing-spinor equations using a radial projector and constructs the type IIB metric and self-dual five-form uplift. Satisfaction of the five- and ten-dimensional equations is an author-reported check, not independently reproduced here.

evidence.text: How do supersymmetry, electromagnetic duality and Seiberg–Witten geometry describe four-dimensional N=2 gauge dynamics, including strong-coupling singularities and superconformal limits? These pedagogical lectures reinterpret established results using developments associated with Gaiotto duality.

sources.title: Noninvertible Symmetries from Holography and Branes

evidence.text: Reduce D5/D7 Wess–Zumino anomaly polynomials to defect actions. Analyze polarization using a truncated non-Abelian DBI action and static matrix solutions proportional to su(2) generators.

sources.title: Branes and Non-Invertible Symmetries

evidence.text: Hamiltonian quantization of twisted Maxwell theory gives electric/magnetic torsion-flux commutators with phase (−1)^(α·β), represented by a Z2 gauge theory. Fusion is then evaluated by changes of path-integral variables and Poincaré duality.

sources.title: Noninvertible Symmetries from Holography and Branes

evidence.text: Treat the radial direction as Hamiltonian time. Vary nondynamical time components to obtain Gauss constraints, exponentiate singular gauge transformations, and introduce auxiliary three-dimensional fields when a genuine boundary operator cannot be obtained by direct integration by parts.

sources.title: Noninvertible Symmetries from Holography and Branes

evidence.text: Obtain bulk topological couplings by reducing the supergravity anomaly form I11 = ½F5 dF5 − F5 H3 F3 on T¹,¹, or through consistent truncation. Dualize c0 to c3 with a Lagrange multiplier; matching the displayed action also requires total derivatives.

sources.title: Branes and Non-Invertible Symmetries

evidence.text: Reduce brane Wess–Zumino couplings and sum over worldvolume gauge fields, retaining induced lower-dimensional brane charges. The full dynamical brane is proposed instead of a bare supergravity holonomy, motivated partly by K-theoretic charge quantization.

sources.title: Branes and Non-Invertible Symmetries

evidence.text: Twisted differential cohomology tracks flat torsion classes, cup products and perfect linking pairings. A central normalization is ∫RP5 ŭ2 ⋆ ŭ4 = 1/2 mod 1; background fluxes are expanded using the twisted generator t̆1.
